mismatch.message: unsupported hero command: an unported branch of this command: weapon skill handling requires #enhance in debug mode

summary: The current boundary is the wizard/debug branch of weapon.c enhance_weapon_skill(). At step 630 the assigned recording enters #enhance and C asks Advance skills without practice? [yn] (n); JavaScript reaches enhance_weapon_skill() but rejects state.wizard before issuing that prompt. The C y answer at step 631 sets speedy=true, making every eligible nonrestricted skill advanceable, then builds a selectable wizard skill menu; j and r advance long sword and polearms and redraw the menu. Port the debug prompt, speedy can_advance branch, wizard skill columns, skill_advance state/message updates, and repeated PICK_ONE loop from weapon.c. This is source-general weapon.c file-port scope, not a seed-specific refusal.

source.branch: In debug/wizard mode, enhance_weapon_skill() calls y_n("Advance skills without practice?"); a y answer sets speedy=TRUE. can_advance() then returns TRUE after restricted/maxed/limit guards without practice or slot checks. The resulting to_advance count selects the wizard-formatted add_skills_to_menu(..., TRUE, TRUE) output and PICK_ONE title; each selected item calls skill_advance(), then the speedy loop repeats while another skill can advance. The witness takes y, selects j then r, and dismisses the repeated menu.
